mapper.select: select mi.id, mi.project_no, mi.name, mi.status, mi.approve_user_name, mi.approve_time, md.id as detailId, md.mould_no, md.third_mould_no, md.type_id, md.mould_holes, md.length, md.width, md.height, md.material, md.life_cycle, md.develop_cycle, md.enable_date, md.supplier_id, md.remark, mi.create_user_name, mi.create_time, md.update_user_name, md.update_time from mould_info mi left join mould_detail md on mi.id = md.main_id and md.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mi.is_deleted = false order by mi.create_time desc, md.id desc

select mi.id, mi.project_no, mi.name, mi.status, md.id as detailId, md.mould_no, md.third_mould_no, md.supplier_id, md.update_time, mra.is_need_refund, mra.refund_standard, mra.refund_order_qty, mra.refund_amount, mra.refund_status from mould_info mi inner join mould_detail md on mi.id = md.main_id and md.is_deleted = false left join mould_refund_agreement mra on md.id = mra.mould_detail_id and mra.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mi.is_deleted = false order by md.create_time desc, md.id desc

select mrcqd.purchase_qty, mrcqd.receive_qty, mrcqd.stock_in_qty, mrcqd.purchase_order_code, mrcqd.po_create_time as createTime, mrcqd.sku_id, mrcqd.sku_no, mrcqd.supplier_id from mould_ref_calc_qty AS mrcq inner join mould_ref_calc_qty_detail AS mrcqd on mrcq.id = mrcqd.main_id and mrcqd.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mrcq.is_deleted = false and mrcq.mould_detail_id = #{params.mouldDetailId} order by mrcqd.po_create_time

select COALESCE(SUM(mra.refund_order_qty), 0) AS refundOrderQty, COALESCE(SUM(mra.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, COALESCE(SUM(mrcq.purchase_qty), 0) AS purchaseQty, COALESCE(SUM(mrcq.receive_qty), 0) AS receiveQty, COALESCE(SUM(mrcq.stock_in_qty), 0) AS stockInQty from mould_info mi inner join mould_detail md on mi.id = md.main_id and md.is_deleted = false left join mould_refund_agreement mra on md.id = mra.mould_detail_id and mra.is_deleted = false left join public.mould_ref_calc_qty mrcq on md.id = mrcq.mould_detail_id and mrcq.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mi.is_deleted = false

select COALESCE(SUM(mrcqd.purchase_qty), 0) AS purchaseQty, COALESCE(SUM(mrcqd.receive_qty), 0) AS receiveQty, COALESCE(SUM(mrcqd.stock_in_qty), 0) AS stockInQty from mould_ref_calc_qty AS mrcq inner join mould_ref_calc_qty_detail AS mrcqd on mrcq.id = mrcqd.main_id and mrcqd.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mrcq.is_deleted = false and mrcq.mould_detail_id = #{params.mouldDetailId}

select mi.project_no, mi.name, mi.status, md.mould_no, md.third_mould_no, md.type_id, md.mould_holes, mp.product_name, mp.images_url, md.length, md.width, md.height, md.material, md.life_cycle, md.develop_cycle, md.enable_date, md.supplier_id, msl.warehouse_id, msl.warehouse_location, msl.address, md.remark, md.create_user_name, md.create_time, md.update_user_name, md.update_time from mould_info mi left join mould_detail md on mi.id = md.main_id and md.is_deleted = false left join public.mould_product mp on md.id = mp.mould_detail_id and mp.is_deleted = false left join mould_store_location msl on md.id = msl.mould_detail_id and msl.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mi.is_deleted = false order by mi.create_time desc, md.id desc

select mi.project_no, mi.name, mi.status, md.mould_no, md.third_mould_no, md.supplier_id, mpp.qty, mpp.tax_price, mpp.tax_rate, mpp.pay_method_id, mpp.payment_condition, mpp.currency, mpp.exchange_rate, mrp.sku_id, mrp.sku_no, mrp.supplier_id as skuSupplierId, mra.is_need_refund, mra.refund_standard, mra.refund_order_qty, mra.refund_amount, mra.refund_status, mrcq.purchase_qty, mrcq.receive_qty, mrcq.stock_in_qty, mrcq.calc_qty - mra.refund_order_qty AS diffQty, md.update_time from mould_info mi left join mould_detail md on mi.id = md.main_id and md.is_deleted = false left join public.mould_purchase_price mpp on md.id = mpp.mould_detail_id and mpp.is_deleted = false left join public.mould_refund_agreement mra on md.id = mra.mould_detail_id and mra.is_deleted = false left join public.mould_ref_product mrp on md.id = mrp.mould_detail_id and mrp.is_deleted = false left join public.mould_ref_calc_qty mrcq on md.id = mrcq.mould_detail_id and mrcq.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mi.is_deleted = false order by md.create_time desc, md.id desc

select md.mould_no, md.third_mould_no, md.supplier_id as mouldSupplierId, mrcqd.purchase_qty, mrcqd.receive_qty, mrcqd.stock_in_qty, mrcqd.purchase_order_code, mrcqd.po_create_time, mrcqd.sku_id, mrcqd.sku_no, mrcqd.supplier_id from mould_detail md inner join mould_ref_calc_qty AS mrcq on md.id = mrcq.mould_detail_id and mrcq.is_deleted = false inner join mould_ref_calc_qty_detail AS mrcqd on mrcq.id = mrcqd.main_id and mrcqd.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mrcq.is_deleted = false and mrcq.mould_detail_id = #{params.mouldDetailId} order by mrcqd.po_create_time
